_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Images/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Images/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Written 2026-10-12 from the code and Docs_UNI_SIM/store-listings/universal-images.md (Data safety): opening, resizing, cropping, converting, reading and stripping metadata, blurring faces and removing backgrounds happen on the device and collect nothing (the face and background models are downloaded from public CDNs; no picture or user data goes with the request); a photo's GPS is read on the device and is not in a backed-up file (it is the re-encoded export). Sign-in (@unisim/sdk) is optional (password, emailed code, or Apple/Google/Microsoft). Back up this image online uploads the edited picture, stored with the account. The suite user count (@unisim/sdk presence.js) is OFF in the phone and desktop apps since 2026-10-12 (src/main.tsx `presence: !isNativeShell() && !isDesktop`), so no install id and no Device or other IDs. App interactions, optional: one session.opened event per launch while signed in (<UsageTracker />), for Analytics. Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
